notes.title: Version 3.13.0 Release
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce the release of DP Animation Maker 3.13.0, which includes new features, animations and improvements. Here is the full list of changes:


 New Animations:

A new Paint Splashes brush has been added.
A new Sand Brush has been added.
A new Fire Sparks brush has been added.
Four new animated types have been added: Bubble, Fire, Smoke, and Wet.
A new Layer Eraser Brush tool has been added.
A new Exude Brush has been added.

Animation Constructor:

A new Random Polyline particle has been added.
A new Paint Splashes particle has been added.
A new Splashes particles have been added.
A new Spots particles have been added.
A new Fog Clouds particles have been added.
A new Thin Smoke Clouds particles have been added.
A new Dust Particle image has been added.
A new Fluid Flow motion has been added.
A new Text origin feature has been added.
A new Freeform Region origin has been added.
A new loop origin has been added.
The Fractal Line particle drawing algorithm has been updated.
A new Length mod has been added for the Fractal Line particle.
A new Shape mode option has been added for the Fractal Line particle.
A new quality option has been added to the trace style.
A new draw order option has been added to the trace style.
The Drift position mod now supports Trace style.
Two Frame templates have been added to Animation.

Bugfixes:

Fixed an error with saving/loading speed parameters in the Fractal Line particle.
A bug with mask drawing after cloning brush layers has been fixed.
The names for properties of Rectangle origin in the Animation Constructor have been corrected.
A bug related to exporting the Lightning animation has been fixed.
A bug with brushes above the particles with shadows has been fixed.
A bug with brushes above the particles with glow has been fixed.
Fixed a visual glitch around the boundaries of imported images.
Fixed a crash that occurred when deleting a layer referenced in the Background Copy Brush.
Corrected the issue of incorrect selection after importing an image into the middle of the layer list.
A bug with the background copy brush has been fixed.
The issue of incorrect brush drawing on vertical pictures has been fixed.
The crash that occurred when entering zero values into group motion timings has been fixed.
The typo on the My Library tab has been fixed.
Some others typing errors have been fixed.
A memory leak has been resolved.

Others:

An option to save settings has been added to the MP4 export dialog.
Added a glow color option for the Fire Sparkle Animation.
A new loop path template has been added to Import Image.
Introduced a preview image for the Background Copy Brush.

notes.title: Version 3.12.0 Release
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=IF4I61yKmuQ;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]

We're pleased to announce the release of DP Animation Maker 3.12.0, which includes new features, improvements and bug fixes. Here is the full list of changes:


    New groping option has been added to Animation List.
    A new path option has been added for Group layers.
    Group positioning support for the following brushes has been added: Wave, Zoom, Rotation, Turn, Stretch, Fold, Radial, Flow (Radial), Flow (Linear), Drift, Bend, Background Copy.
    New timing control has been added to the Animation Constructor
    New Drift in source space option has been added to Blinking Spots and Fixed Spots motions.
    Starting segment option has been added to Wide Line and Wide Curve origins.
    Reference frame option has been added to Vibration mode.
    Magic Tube animation has been reworked and moved to the Templates list of Animation Constructor.
    New color gradient mod has been added to the Animation Constructor
    Mode option has been added to the Rotation brush.
    Angle parameter has been added to the Rotation brush.
    One-way mode has been added to the Shine brush.
    A new “Disable Relative Positioning” option has been added for all motions in the Animation Constructor.
    Crash on stand alone exe has been fixed
    The issue with the Pointing Arrow animation has been successfully addressed.
    A minor bug affecting the copy/paste functionality of animation layers has been rectified.
    Bug causing interference between Heat distortion and Light brushes has been fixed.
    Bug causing incorrect phase in brush sharp mode has been fixed.
    Import button in the add animation dialog has been fixed.
    Bug with save/load of angle property of imported animations has been fixed.
    Bug with save/load of loop animation property of explosion particles has been fixed.
    Fixed an error related to loading certain old projects.
    Resolved desynchronization issues when resetting timings.
    Significantly reduced desynchronization for GIF and frame-by-frame animations.
    Some misprints in user interface have been fixed

notes.notes:

The second addition in this update is a new Magic vortex particle system:

https://vimeo.com/227528074

The third change is an improved Ray of light animation. Ray of light animation has been completely reworked, with new customization options have been added:

We're pleased to announce the release of DP Animation Maker 3.6.3, which includes new trace animated tool and several improvements and bug fixes. Here is the full list of changes: 


New Magic trace animation has been added
The particle properties dialog has been redesigned
The restart function has been enabled for animated brushes
New phase option for the Bend brush has been added
The depended time-line binding problem has been fixed
Some issues with the random time-line have been fixed
The Water rings effect now works correctly in the whole scene animation mode
The bug with particle orientation angle has been fixed
Undo/redo functions have been added for the particle image option
Issue with add-on tabs in the Animation library has been fixed

notes.title: Version 3.6.1 Released
notes.notes:
As you know last year the Steam version of DP Animation Maker was updated once every several months and provided big cumulative updates. This year we plan to issue smaller updates more often to allow the Steam community to enjoy new features sooner. 

Version 3.6.1 adds Flow warping brushes. These brushes were inspired by  works of dozens of artists who created and shared one of the most beautiful animation effects.

Three types of Flow brushes have been added
	
	Linear
	Radial
	Circular
	
The ellipse view control has been improved
The Cloud brush perspective has been improved
The speed control range of Glass Ball effect has been increased
The context menu of the Animation list has been extended
	
	"Rename" command has been added
	"Hide" command has been added
	"Hide All But This" command has been added
	"Unhide All" command has been added
	
Crash when using contact menu in empty the Animation list has been fixed
Crash on export in the Demo version has been fixed
Bug in Navigation Zoom edit has been fixed

notes.title: Version 3.6 Released
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce the release of DP Animation Maker 3.6.0, which includes many new animated tools and bug fixes. Here is the full list of changes: 


New Rain Drops on Glass animation has been added.
Text visual effects have been added
	
	Shadow
	Glow
	Outline
	
Option to change the text background has been added.
Word wrap for text layer has been added.
New particle orientation properties have been added.
DP Animation Maker export has been improved.
	
	Sound export support has been added to AVI export.
	Default AVI compressor was changed to improve export quality.
	New options for MOV export have been added.
	Speed of MOV export has been significantly increased.
	New  options for WMV export have been added.
	The error with frames per second  option in WMV export has been fixed.
	Validation of input parameters has been added to the WMV export dialog.
	
Add animation button on the top bar has been redesigned
The bug with displaying scrolling text has been fixed
The bug with saving Turn brush has been fixed.
The bug with Fog and Magic spot initialization  has been fixed.
The bug with destroying Brush mask on window resize has been fixed.
The bug with exporting the Rings on water effect has been fixed.
The bug with hiding layers in scenes with the Rings on water effect has been fixed.

notes.title: Version 3.5 Released
notes.notes:
DP Animation Maker 3.5 is here and it comes with new animations as well as a bunch of improvements to particle engine and other tools.

Check out the full list of changes: 

 Two new fire animations have been added.
 Stretch Brush has been added.
 Water jet animation has been added.
 The fog animation has been updated.
 New high quality images for the Cloud animations have been added.
 Smooth spline path option has been added available for imported animations.
 A new Time Lines View, where all slide manual timings can be edited simultaneously has been added.
 The depended timing scheme can now have timings that are different from the parent animation’s timings.
 Reset timing action now immediately reloads all particle systems in the scene.
 Five new particle shapes have been added into the Particle Library: Smoke, Heart, Splash, Fire and Fog.
 The option to save a custom particle into the Library has been added.
 Fade In/Out controls for particles have been added.
 Jitter controls for particles have been added.
 The Sum blending mode for particles has been updated.
 The Spin control for particles has been updated.
 Now all particle systems have the full number of particles on load.
 The blending techniques of the Light brush have been significantly improved.
 Constant option has been added to Bend, Drift, Zoom Bend and  Fold brushes.
 Sharp option has been added to Bend, Drift, Bend and Fold brushes.
 Random option has been improved and added to the following brushes: Bend, Drift, Zoom and Fold.
 Animation  controls of Bend and Fold brushes have been redesigned.
 The Cancel button has been added to all the Export process dialogs.
 Fixed incorrect behavior of depended timing scheme in standalone animation applications.
 Fixed the density control of Magic Spot Particle system.
 Fixed the animation editor crash when it loses the DirectX device.
 Fixed a load error for projects with the Smoke animations.
 Fixed timings control bug for the Turn and Fold brushes.
 Old files with the drift brush now open correctly.
 The bug with low density values has been fixed in the particle systems.

notes.title: Version 3.4 Released
notes.notes:
The DP Animation Maker 3.4 update is now live. It adds many improvements and fixes, but most importantly, it adds new features that allow you to construct your own particle effects.

Here's a list of the major changes in this version:

Five new particle systems: Magic Firefly, Magic Fountain, Magic Spots, Magic Burst and Magic Splash
The list of available particle images was replaced with a separate Particle Library
All particle shape and appearance controls were organized in a separate Particle Properties dialog
Timing controls interface was rearranged
New "Depended" timing scheme was added
New "Restart slide animations" button was added
New "Resize/Measure" tool was added to the manual timing interface
Improved representation of manual timings for animations that does not support fade in/out
Custom airbrush and custom pattern brush now support images in PNG and JPEG formats too.

Also known bugs were fixed. Here's a list of recent bug fixes:

Fixed a crash during export in old versions of Windows
Text with transparency is now correctly displayed in stand alone EXEs
Fixed black stripes around a scene in stand alone EXEs
The timeline now works correctly in slideshow mode
Fixed an issue with loading extension packs after opening an existing project
Fixed a crash when adding some animations from extension packs
Fixed an issue with displacing the Light brush cursor
Airbrush cursor now has the correct size when the scene is zoomed
Fixed crash on zooming timeline in manual timing scheme
Fixed crash on undo/redo in manual timing scheme
In finished animations, the moving camera now starts with the correct position
The view port size controls for manual camera path now are updated correctly when background is changed

notes.title: Version 3.2 Released
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce the release of DP Animation Maker 3.2.0, which includes many new animated tools and bug fixes. Here is the full list of changes:

    Added Day to Night Brush that is designed to bring the 24-hour day cycle to any photo or picture with a daytime scene.
    Improved the camera path edit tool and added the ability to set camera zoom in each node of the path individually.
    All air brushes now have size and angle jitter options
    New Slide information tab
    PNG export now has a new Scheme option
    Fixed a scene blur problem with Light and some other brushes
    Removed various controls in text property tabs
    Fixed a typo in PNG export dialog
    Looping PNG export now works correctly
    Fixed an issue with exporting the Electric discharge animation
    Fixed an issue with the hiding Falling stars animation layer
    Each animation layer now has its own timeline duration in Manual mode
    Enabled timeline parameters for the Twinkling stars animation
    Fixed an issue with spin controls in the GIF export dialog
    Fixed a crash during rotating of imported objects
    Fixed an issue with the slide information tab after opening existing project
    Fixed an issue with undo/redo function for fonts

notes.title: Version 3.1 Released
notes.notes:
